backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor indicating backend logic is handled externally.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a Facebook URL update tied to socialLinks.ts.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of autogenerated summaries for frontend files covering styles, components, config, and deployment notes.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Detailed production deployment guide for IC with prerequisites, scripts, troubleshooting, and verification steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer plus custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx into the root div.
frontend/scripts/deploy-ic.ts: Automated IC deployment script running preflight checks, build, and mainnet deploy.
frontend/scripts/preflight-production.ts: Runs TypeScript no‑emit and asset verification checks before production deployment.
frontend/scripts/verify-assets.ts: Checks presence of required static assets under frontend/public/assets before build.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app layout combining header, all sections, footer, and wrapped in an error boundary.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Client‑side validated contact form with inline errors and simulated async submission.
frontend/src/components/ProductionErrorB: Error boundary showing a fallback UI with reload option when runtime errors occur.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section displaying company values and marketing copy with icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact section showing contact details, sanitized phone link, and a contact form.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Hero section with background image, headline content, and CTAs that scroll to other sections.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Services section mapping marketing content to cards with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer component with brand info, quick links, social icons with URL validation, and a generated tracking link.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with scroll behavior, navigation links, brand logo, and mobile menu handling.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Centralized configuration for logo and hero image asset paths.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Marketing copy for hero, about, services, and contact sections with structured content objects.
frontend/src/content/socialLinks.ts: Exports URLs for social media accounts used across the site.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Defines a context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity state and login/logout helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder hook file prepared for future backend queries, currently exporting nothing.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and OKLCH design tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/scrollToSection.ts: Provides a smooth scroll helper that accounts for dynamic header height and buffer spacing.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Adds Vite's type definitions to the TypeScript environment.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, typography, animations, and enabling plugins.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript config for Node-specific Vite build files with ESNext module resolution.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite configuration enabling React, setting aliases, build options, and dev server settings.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, feature requests, and current state including a pending Facebook URL update.
